why: The wage request covers bonuses, allowances and other items beside the base wage; the article that defines what the wage comprises (from memory, the article after 80) would ground those items. Only articles 80 and 88 of the wage chapter are in the store.
To read the article before article 80, which the record cites as the basis of the wage claim.
To read the article after article 88 (payment of wages at the due date); from memory it gives wages priority over other debts, relevant when the employer is insolvent.
From memory, the guaranteed national minimum wage; a wage below it may ground a claim for the difference.
From memory (number uncertain), the employer's duty to deliver a payslip with each payment; payslips are the main proof of what was paid.
From memory (number uncertain, with article 31), the increase owed for overtime hours; the brief's claim includes unpaid overtime, which needs its text.
From memory (number uncertain), the penal provision on the non-payment of wages or of the minimum wage; it bears on the criminal-case exit.
